units: Milliseconds and tokens. Actual requests count observed sent transport attempts.
interpretation: Each condition has six synthetic cases with one retained run per case. These descriptive observations do not establish a general product effect. Capped time is success-dependent and can change after grading correction without any change in actual waiting, raw duration, requests, or tokens.

assumptions: Clusters are independent sampling units.
Case, family and cluster assignments were fixed before outcomes.
Within-cluster dependence is unrestricted; repeats add no independent cluster.
